common.splitOccupiedWordAtPlayhead: Split Word at Playhead on Sync
common.splitOccupiedWordAtPlayheadDesc: When pressing the Sync Next trigger (G) while the playhead is inside a timed word, update that word's end time to the playhead and start the next word there to prevent timing errors.
